sentences.en: The studio is very small, with no place to hide.
sentences.zh: 这个工作室很小，没有藏身之地。

sentences.en: He lived in a little studio apartment in Kabylie, Algeria.
sentences.zh: 他在阿尔及利亚卡布利耶的一个小工作室里生活。

sentences.en: I don't switch on the light in my studio at night.
sentences.zh: 晚上我不开灯在工作室里。

senses.zh: (卧室、厨房、卫生间成一体的)  单间公寓；播音室；录音室；画室；摄影室
